SELECT i.machine_id, i.station_id, COUNT(*) AS incident_count, SUM(CAST(i.false_alarm AS INT)) AS false_alarm_count, ROUND(AVG(CAST(i.false_alarm AS DOUBLE)) * 100, 1) AS false_alarm_share_pct, ROUND(AVG(i.downtime_min), 1) AS avg_downtime_min, ROUND(AVG(i.outdoor_temp_c), 1) AS avg_outdoor_temp_c FROM sf_ops.incidents i WHERE i.kind = 'machine_overheat' GROUP BY i.machine_id, i.station_id ORDER BY false_alarm_share_pct DESC, incident_count DESC
LIMIT 200
